enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Move arm. Scratch head. Turn left again. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Breathe deeply.

Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Hang towel. Open cabinet. Take out clothes. Put on underwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up bowl. Walk to table. Sit on chair. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in dishwasher.

Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out work shirt. Take out work pants. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on work pants. Put on belt. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Open bag. Check contents. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Walk to door.

Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Look at watch. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone again. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nursing station. Pick up clipboard. Read patient notes. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Attend team meeting. Eat lunch in break room. Return to nursing station.
Leave workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board. Take out knife. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop chicken. Open drawer. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pan. Add chicken. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add salt. Add pepper. Cover pan. Turn off stove. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Serve food onto plate. Pick up plate. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat dinner.

Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on couch. Press power button. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll through apps. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ice cream. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Eat ice cream. Watch TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wash face. Dry face. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Put on pajamas.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Move arm. Remain still. Breathe deeply.
